# OJ Valeting

> Mobile car valeting and detailing by Owen, who comes to your home or place of work across Buckinghamshire, Northamptonshire, Oxfordshire, Bedfordshire and Warwickshire (based between Brackley and Buckingham; nationwide too, with a fuel charge further afield). Fully insured. Phone 07708 600114. Call or text to book; online booking at /book/ opens soon.

## Prices (starting prices; Owen confirms the final price after seeing the vehicle)

- [Basic package](/car-valeting/): from £45, 1 to 2 hours
- [Full deep clean](/deep-clean/): from £150, 3 to 5 hours
- [Basic interior clean](/interior-valet/): from £30, inside only
- [Deep interior clean](/deep-interior/): from £130, inside only
- [Basic exterior clean](/exterior-valet/): from £25, outside only
- [Deep exterior clean](/deep-exterior/): from £35, outside only
- [Full paint correction](/paint-correction/): from £170
- [Ceramic coating](/ceramic-coating/): from £270 (3 year, small car), 3, 5 and 7 year options
- [Maintenance package](/maintenance-valet/): from £40, every 2, 4 or 6 weeks
